RIASSTS2-INARI.title: Inari
RIASSTS2-INARI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Welcome, lost soul. Allow me to guide you on your journey.
RIASSTS2-INARI.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.a: My, aren't you a curious one? Please, let me guide your path.
RIASSTS2-INARI.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0:
Poor little kit...
Trapped your own soul in an attempt to save it from extinction.

I.. know you?
Still, you're not the one I'm looking for.
I am not who you seek, but I am your only hope.
RIASSTS2-INARI.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1:
I'm not the one who chained you here, little spirit fox.
Separating from your master, you trapped your mind into the Spire.
I'll break free from this place, mark my words.
RIASSTS2-INARI.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2: I'm sick of seeing your face, false spectre.

Then do what you do best.
Hunt... kill--
And steal your property. Got it.
DARV.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-0.ancient: A new face in the Spire! Where did you come from?
DARV.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0r.ancien: I have the finest wares for ya, feisty canine! None of those clucker buckets though, I'm afraid.
DARV.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-0.ancient: Those Talismans ya got, I can tell they're special.
DARV.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-2.ancient: If, pray tell, you gave up on leaving, you wouldn't mind handing these to your pal Darv, would ya?
NEOW.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-2r.ancien:
..memories.. not lost... for good...
..fight... retrieve them...
NONUPEIPE.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-0.an:
Ah, what a daring soul you are!
Come in, let me take a closer look at your features.
NONUPEIPE.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-2.an:
Such an irascible fighter.
Worry not, I only wish to bestow you my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0r.a: Your manners, my dear. You must be hungry.
NONUPEIPE.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-0.an: I've prepared a fine gift for you to take back to your master.
NONUPEIPE.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-1.an: Oh, your unyielding devotion is so beautiful to witness.
OROBAS.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-0.ancie: An outsider!? Real or ghost?? Fox or man??!
OROBAS.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0.ancie:
God servant? What god?? Can god swim?!
Walk on water? Exciting!
OROBAS.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-0r.anci:
Take take!! These help go home! Architect help for sure!
Come back soon?
PAEL.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0r.ancien:
Make yourself comfortable...
A nap never hurt anyone...
PAEL.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-1r.char: The Blood Kitsune curls up on a nearby rag.
PAEL.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-0.ancient:
Little drowsy fox...
I hope my flesh aids your freedom...
TANX.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-0.ancient: WARRIOR! I KNOW STRENGTH WHEN I SEE IT!
TANX.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0r.ancien: CLAWS SHARP! BUT WEAPONS ARE SHARPER!!
TEZCATARA.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-0.an: Your spirit burns so longingly! Come, you must be hungry!
TEZCATARA.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0r.a:
Your flames are so impatient today.
Still no sight of your special person?
TEZCATARA.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-1r.a: Ohh, to be motivated by love!
TEZCATARA.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-0.an: Your appetite is quite a sight my dear. A sign of good health.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-: Killing you will free me from this place.

Is that what you think?
Misguided fool.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-: Your own mind is your jailer
I will return to Kain's side!
You cannot return, until you're whole again
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-0.ancien:
How interesting!
A demon already under a contract?
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-1.char: It's not a contract. My pledge is without terms.
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.0-2.ancien: That tattoo on your shoulder tells me otherwise.
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.1-0r.ancie: I can cut you a better deal than whatever you have going on right now.
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-0.ancien:
Take a closer look, my fiend friend.
I can restore your memories and in exchange--
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-1.char:
Save your breath, I know a demon's dealings by heart.
I'm not stupid enough to make deals with you.
VAKUU.talk.RIASSTS2-RIAS_STS2.2-2.ancien: And yet you've agreed to an even worse sentence.
